title: apricity prune: remove one-star rated items via the GraphQL backend
description: Utility that signs in as a curator, queries the backend (AppSync/Amplify, web/amplify/data/resource.ts) for the caller's Rating rows with stars=1 on samples and clips, and removes those items. Removal: backend records (Sample, Clip, Candidate, Verdict, CrateItem, Marker, Rating, Comment), bucket files (audio/analysis), local audio, .apricity.json manifest and stems. Items a ScoreRef still uses are retired, not deleted (existing Clip.retired logic). Adds a tombstone list (sha256/catalog path) so 'apricity sources fetch' and future ingests never resurrect pruned audio. Dry run by default; --apply deletes. Findings: Rating is owner-only (allow.owner) so the CLI only sees the signed-in user's ratings; Sample/Clip delete needs curators group; Ratings are cloud-only (import-library.ts CLOUD_ONLY); Rust judge does not validate 1-5 stars. Spec first (features/), Rust only in the CLI, coordinate any web change via the web-session issue.
